def weighted_distance_sums(n: int, edges: list[list[int]], w: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    adj: list[list[int]] = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v in edges:
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)

    parent = [-1] * n
    depth = [0] * n
    order = [0]
    root_sum = 0

    for u in order:
        pu = parent[u]
        du = depth[u]
        root_sum += w[u] * du
        next_d = du + 1
        for v in adj[u]:
            if v != pu:
                parent[v] = u
                depth[v] = next_d
                order.append(v)

    sub_w = list(w)
    for u in reversed(order):
        p = parent[u]
        if p != -1:
            sub_w[p] += sub_w[u]

    total_w = sub_w[0]
    ans = [0] * n
    ans[0] = root_sum

    for u in order[1:]:
        p = parent[u]
        ans[u] = ans[p] + total_w - 2 * sub_w[u]

    return ans
